public_rationale: The disclosed arrangement differs materially from the claimed sequence. Anthropic's filing identifies equipment leases with Broadcom, including an agreement dated March 31, 2026. Reporting on that agreement identifies Google as the hardware seller, Broadcom as purchaser and lessor, and an Anthropic subsidiary as lessee. The record therefore contradicts the assertion that Anthropic buys these TPUs from Google and then rents them back from Google. Separate Google Cloud service purchases do not establish that sequence.
limitations: The detailed hardware purchase chain relies partly on reporting because the executed exhibit was unavailable through read_page.
The finding concerns the transaction structure, not whether the broader financing relationships are economically desirable or demonstrate independent demand.
The decisive disclosure appeared after the post but before the evaluation cutoff and describes a pre-post agreement.
